content: संश्लिष्ट {%<ab>p. p.</ab>%} .²1 Clasped or pressed together, joined, united. .²2 Embraced. .²3 Adjoining, lying close or contiguous to. .²4 Furnished or endowed with, having. .²5 Related, connected together; यथा छायातपौ नित्यं सुसंबद्धौ परस्परम् . एवं कर्म च कर्ता च संश्लिष्टावितरेतरम् .. <ls>Pt. 2. 127</ls>. .²6 Confused, indeterminate. .{@-ष्टः@} A kind of pavilion. .{@-ष्टम्@} A heap, mass, multitude.
